source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: FindFolderWithId records a failed remote-ID property read before calling GetURI for diagnostics. A successful URI lookup cannot replace that failure with NS_OK. The scan continues and can still return a later matching folder; another failed diagnostic may replace the retained error with a different failure. Update and creation callers propagate failed lookup before dereferencing, while the delete caller deliberately treats absence as already deleted.
title: Folder lookup failure must survive a successful diagnostic lookup
